name: Frame Window Counter
description: Real-time physics-tick / CBF input window counter with pitch-shifted ding feedback.

ding-on-update.name: Ding on counter update
ding-on-update.description: Plays a (throttled, 10/s) ding from the per-frame phase counter.

pitch-sharpness.name: Pitch sharpness
pitch-sharpness.description: <1 = pitch falls off fast near on-tick, >1 = stays high longer.

tps.name: Physics TPS
tps.description: Set to match your TPS bypass value.
